test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

STYE : UVAE :: ELSE : ENUE :: MINE : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 
• Vowels → No change.
 
• Consonants → (2) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• STYE : UVAE

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fc9fd23027a62cb0a3e6193c204d61280da9af6a3986e80db4eeeb440f9f336.png] 

And,

 
• ELSE : ENUE

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/caf369d7dda2a75456aa83ece9d7cba70835525262822dc537c9ff75c7c72734.png] 

Similarly,

 
• MINE : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/141d0a79d4b6f64029bbfbd1d431b9cac32ae0017c320d7a6fd01ac8c005586a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**OIPE**".

a4:T
